## Setup

Load up settings for this script

```{r}
#| echo: false
rm(list=ls())

library(tidyverse)

path <- file.path("C:","Users","User","Box","Metascience","Sample data") #change filepath as necessary

winning_team <- "009" #which team do we want to look at - with full dataset can examine non-winners, in sample only winner data included
division_unit_1 = 0.1 #use to determine resolution of binning
division_unit_2 = 1000

```

## Load essential files

```{r}
#| echo: false

setwd(path)

#survey data - pre-sampled, the code in this file will work on the complete survey data when published

survey_data <- read_csv("sample_human_survey_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

#data from the winning tool - pre-sampled, results from lower-placed teams pre-removed

tool_results <- read_csv("Algorithms_Merged.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

#sampling settings

conversion_table <- read_csv("sampling_table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

#OpenAlex data - for speed the Rds file only contains full bibliometric data for the sample

OA_data <- readRDS("OA_data.Rds") #this data was generated before the recent OpenAlex topic update, so an additional file is needed for up-to-date topic data
OA_subject_data <- read_csv("OA_flat_subject_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) #updated topic data - included in the output data

#data provided by winning team indicating full text status

ft <- read_csv("full_text_status.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

#minor data shaping

OA_data <- OA_data %>% select(-Keywords,-domain,-field,-subfield,-topic) %>% #remove outdated topic data (pre-OpenAlex update)
  distinct(DOI, .keep_all = TRUE) #at the time this was generated OA occasionally had multiple items with the same DOI, remove duplicates

OA_data <- full_join(OA_data,OA_subject_data, by = "DOI") %>% #add in current topic data
  select(PaperProjectID,DOI,OpenAlexID,Title,Date,topics) %>% 
  rename(Paper_ID = PaperProjectID) %>%
  mutate(Date = as_date(parse_date_time(Date, orders = c("ymd","dmy")))) #standardise date formats

ft <- ft %>% filter(str_detect(category,"fulltext_cc_by"))

ft_slim <- ft %>% select(doi)

tool_results <- tool_results %>%
  select(`DOI (as URL)`,
         contains(paste0("Converted_",winning_team)),
         contains(paste0("Raw_Certainty_",winning_team))) %>% #retain DOI and scores for winning team only
  rename(DOI = `DOI (as URL)`) %>%
  rename(team_score = contains("Converted")) %>%
  rename(team_bounds = contains("Certainty")) %>% #rename columns
  select(-team_bounds) #remove a column unused in final output

```

## Small sample from human data (selection on human data)

10 publications of human data, or 1000 of tool

```{r}
#| echo: false

setwd(path)

#set output filenames

filename <- "org_sci_sample_fresh_generation.csv"
filename_survey_sample <- "org_sci_sample_survey_only.csv"

#furnish survey data with additional fields

survey_data_furnished <- survey_data %>%
  select(DOI, n_raters, novel_quant_median, novel_quant_std, novel_quant_range) %>%
  rename(NumExpertRaters = n_raters, Expert_Median = novel_quant_median, Expert_StdDev = novel_quant_std, Expert_Range = novel_quant_range)

survey_data_furnished <- survey_data_furnished %>%
  left_join(OA_data, by = "DOI") %>%
  relocate(Title,Date, .before = NumExpertRaters) %>%
  relocate(OpenAlexID, .after = DOI) %>%
  relocate(Paper_ID)

survey_data_furnished <- survey_data_furnished %>%
  filter(NumExpertRaters > 1)

#restrict team data to publications where full texts were available, and where human data had multiple raters

tool_results <- tool_results %>%
  semi_join(ft_slim, by = join_by(DOI == doi)) %>% #full text
  filter(DOI %in% survey_data_furnished$DOI)

#add a converted score

tool_results <- tool_results %>%
    mutate(team_score_conversion = pmin(floor(team_score/division_unit_1) + 1,
      division_unit_2))
  
#label by bin
  
tool_results <- tool_results %>%
    mutate(category = ifelse(team_score_conversion %in% conversion_table[[1,3]]:conversion_table[[1,4]],conversion_table[[1,1]], #negligible category - lower bound, upper bound, label
                             ifelse(team_score_conversion %in% conversion_table[[2,3]]:conversion_table[[2,4]],conversion_table[[2,1]], #routine
                                    ifelse(team_score_conversion %in% conversion_table[[3,3]]:conversion_table[[3,4]],conversion_table[[3,1]], #incremental
                                           ifelse(team_score_conversion %in% conversion_table[[4,3]]:conversion_table[[4,4]],conversion_table[[4,1]], #solid
                                                  ifelse(team_score_conversion %in% conversion_table[[5,3]]:conversion_table[[5,4]],conversion_table[[5,1]], #field-defining
                                                         ifelse(team_score_conversion %in% conversion_table[[6,3]]:conversion_table[[6,4]],conversion_table[[6,1]],"error"))))))) #paradigm-shifting
  
#sample by bin
  
tool_results_sample <- tool_results %>%
    left_join(conversion_table, by = join_by(category == category_name)) %>%
    group_by(category) %>%
    group_modify(~ slice_sample(.x, n = first(.x$desired_sample))) %>% #modify the entire group - output tbl, apply function slice sample to self
    arrange(team_score_conversion)
  
#combine datasets and convert to output format

tool_results_sample <- tool_results_sample %>%
    select(-team_score_conversion,-desired_sample,-lower_bound,-upper_bound) %>% #remove conversion table data
    relocate(DOI,team_score,category)
  
combined_sample <- left_join(tool_results_sample,survey_data_furnished, by = "DOI") %>% 
  relocate(team_score,category, .after = Expert_Range) %>% distinct(DOI, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  add_column(Shibayama_q100 = "", Shibayama_q90 = "", Matsumoto = "", Leahey = "")

#write outputs

write_excel_csv(combined_sample,filename)
write_excel_csv(survey_data_furnished,filename_survey_sample)

```
